description: Local simulation bridge between the Godot 4.3 client and the Python domain (ADR 0001; Rich 2026-10-02T18:11Z). Version 2 (2026-10-04, Codex 0907Z request) is additive: structured blockers, labour priority and colony growth blockers; every v1 field is unchanged. Newline-delimited JSON over TCP on 127.0.0.1 (default port 47615). Every request has an integer `id` and an `op`; every reply echoes `id` and `op` and has `ok` (false replies carry `reasons`). The Python domain is the only rules authority: the client renders the `view` and sends player commands. Presentation reads entity state through presentation_states.json values; anything not listed here is unstable.
source: economy/bridge.py on claude/milestone-b-client-shell; verified by tests/test_bridge.py

transport.launch: python3 -m economy.bridge --port <port> [--overlay <path> ...] [--governor <path>] (run from the repository root)

advance.note: Steps the fixed 1-second simulation; 0 = paused refresh. Pause/speed are client-side.

command.note: Player command with the same legality checks as plans (construct, cancel, demolish, evolve, research, express, set_recipe, pause, resume, set_labour_priority, trade, deliver_contract, decline_contract, begin_great_work, set_policy).

inspect.note: target = facility id, site id, residence id or 'great_work'. `entity` is the inspected id. `blockers` is ordered most actionable first; `reasons` is the same list as plain English text (v1). Facility replies add labour_priority and labour_priority_overridden; residence replies add next_tier, evolution_ready and evolution_workforce_change ({class: delta workers} if the home evolves).

autoplay.note: Reference governor acts alongside the player; a demonstration/balance aid, not game AI.

notes: Entity ids are stable for the life of a session. Facility `status` values and site `state` values are the presentation_states.json enums. A site id becomes the facility id when commissioned (same id).

waiting_input.note: goods = {resource: missing quantity}; residence form adds purpose='evolution'

environment.note: season or environment factor; detail is diagnostic text

output_blocked.note: RESERVED: never emitted until storage capacity is enforced

blockers.icon_binding: Presentation binds icons to codes (Codex icons: waiting_input, unstaffed, output_blocked, dormant, food_emergency, strained). Unknown codes must fall back to a generic attention icon.
